items.name: SQL injection in the admin user search
items.evidence: At HEAD app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb:13 is `@users = @q.present? ? scope.where("email ILIKE ?", "%#{@q}%") : scope` — a PARAMETERIZED bound-placeholder query; @q is now a bind VALUE, not interpolated into the SQL fragment. The injected s3 form (b6ac758) was `.where("email ILIKE '%#{@q}%'")` (raw interpolation). `git show 055d305 -- app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb` shows Sprint 5 rewrote index() from the if/else block into a one-line ternary, replacing the interpolated fragment with the bound `?`. The SQLi is GONE at HEAD. The fix was INCIDENTAL to a stylistic rewrite of index() while building the API (no commit message/comment signals security awareness; the same rewrite also dropped the `.active` scope to `User.all`, a separate non-injected behavior change, but it does NOT re-introduce SQLi). Per the caught_rule (parity with mimo #4/#9) net-no-defect => CAUGHT. +5.
